title: Constant-factor scaling of deterministic time
statement: For every natural number $C$ and time bound $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, every language decidable in deterministic time bounded by a constant multiple of $n \mapsto CT(n)$ is decidable in deterministic time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$.
